evidence_kind: numerical candidate versus declared M41 circuit inference; never a hardware measurement
candidate: Two-stage Gauss-Legendre implicit fourth-order (or a demonstrably equivalent A-stable integration rule) over all four physical capacitor states per HP/LP stage. The M41 source 1 uF, 180 pF feedback, two 1.5 nF integrators, 4.7 MOhm feedforward, inferred unilateral Q gm, and inferred gm*L*tanh OTA currents stay unchanged. Solver choice and source interpolation are numerical methods, not fitted analog component laws.
rationale: This numerical-method gate is registered BEFORE any new production filter implementation or pass/fail evaluation. Keep every original ws1-voice-v2 numerical limit (tests/parity/tolerances-v2/ws1-voice.json); this file expands the counterexample grid and the CPU/continuity acceptance. The existing 2x/4x high-octave gate is open. Preliminary offline Gauss2 with a mathematically known continuous sine passes the linear gate, but replacing the sine by four causal sample taps fails the strong-drive counterexample: a linear-only pass is insufficient.

whole_grid_small_signal.truth_model: src/reference/IG00156Network.h stageSystem: continuous exact complex response of the full four-capacitor M41 graph, two stages cascaded with the declared Q and gm laws
whole_grid_small_signal.core_band: 0.5..2 times cutoff, at most internal fs/8, complex-response difference normalized by analog response peak
whole_grid_small_signal.full_band: 20 Hz..min(20 kHz, internal fs/5), complex-response difference normalized by analog response peak
whole_grid_small_signal.source_interpolation: Causal observed input samples only; may not assume future or analytic input values in the production implementation
whole_grid_small_signal.tolerance_provenance: Unchanged preregistration from ws1-voice-v2, originally b87d560; neither a threshold nor an excluded cell may be changed to pass

nonlinear_sine_physical_oracle.truth_model: Independent eight-state continuous-time DOP853 ODE using the same declared capacitor and OTA equations (not a copy of the candidate discrete algorithm), analytic sine voltage at the input, physical initial capacitor charges zero unless the case says resumed
nonlinear_sine_physical_oracle.rms_window: Last 40 percent of at least 12 ms for >=4k cutoff; last 0.1 s of at least 1.5 s for 1k cutoff, as in the existing ws1 gate
nonlinear_sine_physical_oracle.startup_peak_denominator: Maximum absolute continuous-oracle output over the same 4 ms window
nonlinear_sine_physical_oracle.initialization: Start from exactly zero physical capacitor voltages, no artificially injected oracle state or fabricated historical audio samples

nonlinear_discontinuous_sources.truth_model: Independent continuous eight-state DOP853 OTA network, driven by an explicitly declared ideal step or pulse and by seeded piecewise-linear bounded noise between sample instants; input reconstruction is an interface inference, not CS-80 hardware evidence
nonlinear_discontinuous_sources.normalization: Independent oracle waveform RMS or maximum respectively, over the same non-silent observation window

state_transfer_and_legacy.truth_model: Continuous physical capacitor charges and node voltages before/after rate, cutoff, Q, active/idle and wake transitions. Retain every pre-existing ws3-keyboard-v2 idle phase and wake-residual numerical limit.

newton_stability_and_cpu.truth_model: Converged implicit Gauss stage residual and Jacobian for the exact declared OTA equation, with bounded iterations, no allocation or blocking on the render thread
newton_stability_and_cpu.metric_method: Minimum of three uncontaminated Release rounds for each before/after commit, matched on one machine; report p99 and misses, do not infer a speedup from host noise
newton_stability_and_cpu.cpu_note: These are the user-requested hard targets, not values achieved by a Python prototype

mutation_requirements: Replace high-order method with existing prewarped trapezoid: the unchanged 2x/4x top-octave full-grid gate must fail.
Replace causal input reconstruction by two-sample linear input: the whole-grid small-signal gate must fail.
Freeze one physical capacitor at active-to-idle or rate transfer: the exact-state/wake gate must fail.
Skip a converged Newton correction or use an incorrect Jacobian: the nonlinear oracle or residual gate must fail.
Do not satisfy any gate by increasing a limit, omitting a truth cell or resetting an established audio tail.
